what: The story spoken, and the sound effects, for the globe. Made by build/make-audio.mjs.

477ba9cf.text: It begins with Plato, who has it told as “a tale which, though strange, is certainly true”.
477ba9cf.said: It begins with Plato, who has it told as “a tale which, though strange, is certainly true”.

9ee0fb8e.text: Beyond the Pillars of Heracles, out in the Atlantic, lay an island “larger than Libya and Asia put together”.
9ee0fb8e.said: Beyond the Pillars of Heracles, out in the Atlantic, lay an island “larger than Libya and Asia put together”.

f3fc592d.text: At its heart stood a city of rings: sea, then land, then sea again. A temple coated with silver. A wall that “sparkled like fire”.
f3fc592d.said: At its heart stood a city of rings: sea, then land, then sea again. A temple coated with silver. A wall that “sparkled like fire”.

2359c097.text: Then, “in a single day and night of misfortune”, Atlantis “disappeared in the depths of the sea”.
2359c097.said: Then, “in a single day and night of misfortune”, Atlantis “disappeared in the depths of the sea”.

c1b5be7e.text: Plato sets this nine thousand years before Solon: about 9600 BCE. That part can be checked.
c1b5be7e.said: Plato sets this nine thousand years before Solon: about 9600 BCE. That part can be checked.

cf4d656f.text: The sea stood about 50 m lower then. Since that date, 10.9 million km² of land have gone under. All of it is glowing now.
cf4d656f.said: The sea stood about 50 metres lower then. Since that date, 10.9 million square kilometres of land have gone under. All of it is glowing now.

f15baa91.text: We tested every 10 km of it against his words. Nothing on Earth scores 5 of 5. The closest, the Great Bahama Bank, scores 4: a match in the landscape, not a city.
f15baa91.said: We tested every 10 kilometres of it against his words. Nothing on Earth scores 5 of 5. The closest, the Great Bahama Bank, scores 4: a match in the landscape, not a city.

bfaff9d6.text: People have gone looking since 1679. Of 32 searches on record, 7 were shown wrong, 5 were corrected, and 8 are still open. Not one has found the city.
bfaff9d6.said: People have gone looking since 1679. Of 32 searches on record, 7 were shown wrong, 5 were corrected, and 8 are still open. Not one has found the city.

24388c0f.text: So we built his city as he wrote it, each part tied to a line of his text.
24388c0f.said: So we built his city as he wrote it, each part tied to a line of his text.

b93b2c45.text: At its centre he put a shrine, “reserved as holy ground, and encircled with a wall of gold”. We opened it. Inside is everything found so far, and everything still unknown.
b93b2c45.said: At its centre he put a shrine, “reserved as holy ground, and encircled with a wall of gold”. We opened it. Inside is everything found so far, and everything still unknown.

420750e6.text: Walk in. The search is yours now.
420750e6.said: Walk in. The search is yours now.

ping.prompt: A single clean submarine sonar ping, deep and resonant, with a long watery echo tail. No music.

lock.prompt: A short soft rising two-note chime, glassy and bright, like an instrument locking onto a target. No music, no voice.

tick.prompt: One crisp, clearly audible click of a mechanical switch being pressed. Close, dry, loud enough to hear plainly.

rise.prompt: A deep rumbling swell of sea water rising and flooding slowly over land, a low whoosh that builds then settles. No music.

reveal.prompt: A deep cinematic boom with a long shimmering tail, the moment of a discovery. No melody, no voice.

deep.prompt: Deep underwater ambience: a slow low hum, distant muffled currents, faint far-off whale-like tones. Calm, continuous, no music.

bed.prompt: A slow dark ambient drone, mysterious and ancient: sustained low strings and a soft choir pad. No melody, no percussion, continuous.

step.prompt: One single soft footstep of a leather sandal on smooth stone paving. Close, dry, quiet. Nothing else.

city.prompt: A calm ancient harbour by the sea on a bright day: gentle water lapping against stone quays, a light steady breeze, a few distant gulls. Continuous, even, no music, no voices, no engines.
